title: A Day in the Life of a Family at minus 71 Celsius
description:
Follow an ordinary winter day with a family living in Yakutia, one of the coldest inhabited places on Earth. Discover how daily routines, from school walks to gathering water and firewood, adapt to extreme sub-zero temperatures.

Learn how traditions, craftsmanship, and strong community bonds allow this family not just to survive, but to thrive in a harsh climate. See the true meaning of resilience and warmth beyond the thermometer.

#Yakutia #ExtremeSurvival #ColdestPlaceOnEarth #Documentary #WinterLife
